I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team. The reply says she's on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15), can be reached on mobile, and that teammates who need her before midday should call or text.

I couldn't check her calendar, so I don't know if anything is booked for that time. The calendar tool only shows my own events, and that came back empty for tomorrow. My notes didn't have anything about tomorrow either.

One correction: my reply calls Ilse "her," but she hasn't said what pronouns she uses. Posted messages can't be edited, so if you'd like, I can post a short follow-up that uses her name instead.
